title: [macOS Tahoe] screencapture via exec tool fails — TCC Screen Recording permission not inherited by Gateway LaunchAgent

labels.name: stale
labels.description: Marked as stale due to inactivity

body:
## Description

On macOS 15 (Tahoe), running `screencapture` (or `/usr/sbin/screencapture`) via the exec tool always fails with:

```
could not create image from display
```

This happens even when the parent app (Terminal, OpenClawNode, etc.) has been granted Screen Recording permission in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen Recording.

## Root Cause

macOS Tahoe's TCC (Transparency, Consent, and Control) framework evaluates Screen Recording permissions based on the **responsible process**, not the parent process. When OpenClaw's Gateway runs as a LaunchAgent (via plist) or through a wrapper script:

1. The TCC permission is granted to the wrapper/Terminal/node binary
2. But `screencapture` spawned by the exec tool is attributed to a different process in TCC's view
3. Using `exec` in a wrapper script replaces the process, causing the child `node` process to be the TCC target instead of the wrapper — and `node` doesn't have Screen Recording permission

## Steps to Reproduce

1. macOS 15.x (Tahoe), Gateway running as LaunchAgent
2. Grant Screen Recording to Terminal/OpenClawNode in System Settings
3. Run via exec tool: `/usr/sbin/screencapture -x /tmp/test.png`
4. Result: `could not create image from display`

## Expected Behavior

`screencapture` should work when the Gateway's parent process has Screen Recording permission.

## Workaround

- Use Playwright browser screenshots instead of system-level `screencapture` (works for web content)
- Manually grant Screen Recording to the exact `node` binary that Gateway uses (path depends on version manager: fnm/nvm/mise)

## Notes

- Related to #11256 (`/usr/sbin` missing from PATH) — even with full path, TCC blocks it
- Related to #8618 and #10753 (TCC permission issues on macOS)
- The `exec` keyword in LaunchAgent wrapper scripts makes this worse by replacing the authorized process

## Environment

- **OS:** macOS 15.2 Tahoe (arm64)  
- **Node:** v25.6.0 (via fnm)
- **Gateway:** LaunchAgent with wrapper script
- **OpenClaw channel:** Telegram
